route_title: Core-Zone Sinusoidal Perturbation on 21-Layer Defect Cavity
compilation_rationale: Bounded 21-layer Ta2O5/SiO2 defect-cavity bandpass filter compiled with fixed alternating sequence on fused silica. Initial thicknesses from the provided candidate vector assigned directly. Thickness bounds applied per cavity (400–650 nm) and mirror (50–350 nm) specifications. Three mean_transmittance objectives enforce the passband peak and dual stopband suppressions at normal incidence within the coherent regime.
